system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

Your voice box and vocal cords are replaced and augmented. This allows you to change your voice to mimic a wide range of sounds in addition to simply disguising it. You get a +2 bonus on Communication (Deception) tests involving vocal mimicry and to Communication (Performing) tests for singing. A cybernetic larynx might be further augmented with a sonic or ultrasonic Weapon Implant (see Weapon Implant, following) but that is considered a separate augmentation.

Game modifiers on this item: commTest +2 (Communication (Deception) vocal mimicry and Communication (Performing) singing, off). Items apply their modifiers while equipped; switch the ones that are off on when they apply.
